name: Call of Air
summary: At Grommash Hold, Searn Firewarder sends seasoned shamans south to seek the Air Totem. Prate Cloudseer guides them toward the final elemental pillar of their craft.

sections.title: A Breath from the South
sections.body: A shaman who has earned the favor of earth, fire, and water now stands ready to harness air, the last of the four elements. In Orgrimmar, troll trainer Searn Firewarder recognizes when a disciple has reached the height of early training and is prepared for this final foundational step. He sends the shaman south across the Barrens, then down into the canyon labyrinth of Thousand Needles.

sections.title: The Cloudseer's Hermitage
sections.body: Prate Cloudseer waits in a high cave among the sandstone mesas of Thousand Needles. The hermit lives quietly with her partner, far from Horde encampments. She demands deference before revealing the secrets of the wind. Meet her with proper respect, and she shares the knowledge and focus to manifest the Air Totem, completing the shaman's elemental circle.

aliases: where to get call of air
faq.answer: Searn Firewarder, a troll shaman trainer in Grommash Hold, offers this to qualified shamans when they reach the appropriate experience.

faq.q: Where can I find Prate Cloudseer?
faq.answer: Prate Cloudseer lives in Thousand Needles. After taking the Great Lift down from the southern Barrens, head east across the canyon floor to find her cave.

faq.q: What is the Air Totem used for?
faq.answer: The Air Totem is the fourth and final elemental focus a shaman acquires. It lets a shaman invoke air spells and totems, with speed, grace, and wind-based powers.

faq.q: Why does Searn Firewarder send you so far away?
faq.answer: Mastery of the elements requires finding mentors devoted to communing with specific spirits. Prate Cloudseer knows the winds of the shifting canyon gusts in Thousand Needles, making her the ideal guide to air.

faq.q: Do I need to complete other elemental totem quests first?
aliases: can i do air totem first
faq.answer: Yes. Shaman training follows a strict progression through the elements: earth, then fire and water, and finally air.

faq.q: Are there other versions of this quest for different cities?
faq.answer: Yes. Shaman trainers in other Horde capitals, including Thunder Bluff, give their own directions to Prate Cloudseer in Thousand Needles.

angles.text: The Air Totem is the culminating milestone of your early shamanic journey. It lets you call on wind spirits alongside earth, fire, and water.
The shamanic tradition ties the Horde's diverse races together. Far-flung elders and hermits across central Kalimdor pass down its sacred customs.
